data.body: [P2] Continue owner-thread end-hook cleanup after the first fatal. `runOperationHook` stops dispatch immediately, so if an earlier plugin's end hook throws fatally, later plugins such as OTel never close their attempt scopes on the owning worker. Invocation finalization can then close/release them from another thread, leaking trace or MDC context into worker reuse. Accumulate the first fatal while dispatching the remaining end hooks, then notify the invocation and rethrow it; add a regression with a faulty plugin ordered before OTel.
